spans.s:
अर्व् अर्व्, cl. 1. P. अर्वति, आनर्व, अर्वि-
तुम्, to hurt, kill.

अर्व अर्व, (in comp.) hither, towards, near
to.
—अर्व-वसु, उस्, m. one of the seven principal
rays of the sun.

अर्वट अर्वट, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. अर्व्),
ashes.
अर्वश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. possessed of coursers, quick.

अर्वाच् अर्वाच्, वाङ्, वाची, वाक् (fr. rt. अञ्च्
with अर्व; cf. अर्वन्), coming hitherward; turned
towards, coming to meet any one; being on this side
[]
(as the bank of a river); being below or behind,
turned down or downwards; following, subsequent.

अर्वाक्, ind. (with abl.) hitherward; on this side;
from a certain point; before, after; on the lower side
of, behind, downwards; (with loc.) within; near.
—अर्वाक्कालिक, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to proxi-
mate time, modern.
—अर्वाक्कालिक-ता, f. modern-
ness, posteriority of time.
—अर्वाक्-कूल, अम्, n. the
near bank of a river.
—अर्वाक्-सामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved.
epithet of three days, during which a Soma sacrifice
is performed.
—अर्वाक्-स्रोतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, N. of a
creation of beings in which the current of nutriment
tends downwards.
—अर्वाग्-बिल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
having the mouth hitherward.
—अर्वाग्-वसु, उस्, उस्,
उ, Ved. offering riches.

आर्वाक् आर्वाक्, ind. after, afterwards, be-
hind. See अर्वाक्.
अर्वाके, ind., Ved. in the proximity of, near to.

अर्वाचीन, अस्, आ, अम्, turned towards; favouring;
being on this side or below (with abl.); born after-
wards, posterior, recent, modern; reverse, contrary.
—अर्वाचीन-ता, f. or अर्वाचीन-त्व, अम्, n. state of
being posterior, recent or contrary.

अर्वाचीनम्, ind. (with abl.) on this side of;
thenceforward, thence onward; less than.

अर्वावत् अर्वा-वत्, त्, f., Ved. proximity [cf.
परा-वत्]; being near.

अर्वावसु अर्वा-वसु, उस्, m., Ved. N. of the
Hotṛ; N. of the Brahman of the gods.

अर्वुक अर्वुक, अस्, m., N. of a tribe or peo-
ple in the Mahā-bhārata.

अर्वाक्तन, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, being on this side,
not reaching to the other side.
